lines.text: The prayer asks the LORD to remember their disgrace, and says they must buy their water and their wood.
To get enough bread they submitted to Egypt and Babylon, and slaves rule over them.
They get bread at the risk of their lives, and young men toil at millstones.
Their joy is gone and their dancing has turned to anger, because Mount Zion lies desolate.
The prayer says the LORD reigns forever, and asks Him to restore them to Himself and renew their days.
